scheme_name: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)
description:
The "Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII" is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh.

This scheme was launched in the year 2016.

It is also known as the Sahuji Maharaj Assistance Scheme.

The primary objective of this scheme is to encourage and motivate Scheduled Caste students to excel in their academic pursuits.

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to those students who achieve top ranks in their respective state and district level examinations for classes X and XII.

The government has set measurable targets to ensure that a significant number of Scheduled Caste students benefit from this initiative.

Each year, the scheme aims to recognize and reward students who secure the first three ranks at both the state and district levels.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme varies based on the rank achieved by the student.

For students securing the first rank in the state level examination, a monetary award of ₹50,000 is provided.

Students who secure the second rank at the state level receive an award of ₹30,000.

Those who achieve the third rank at the state level are awarded ₹20,000.

At the district level, the awards are also structured similarly.

Students securing the first rank at the district level receive ₹25,000.

The second rank holders at the district level are awarded ₹15,000.

Students who secure the third rank at the district level receive ₹10,000.

This financial assistance is intended to alleviate the economic burden on the families of these students and encourage them to pursue higher education.

To be eligible for this scheme, students must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.

There is no specific age limit mentioned for eligibility.

However, students must have appeared for the state or district level examinations for classes X or XII.

The students must secure a rank within the top three positions in their respective categories.

The income criteria for eligibility are also significant.

The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed ₹2 lakh.

This income limit ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of the Scheduled Caste community.

The application process for this scheme is straightforward and designed to be accessible.

Students must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Uttar Pradesh.

The application form requires basic personal details such as name, address, and educational qualifications.

Students must also provide details of their examination results, including rank and marks obtained.

In addition to the application form, students must submit certain documents.

These documents include a caste certificate issued by a competent authority.

Students must also provide proof of their examination results.

This can be in the form of a mark sheet or a certificate from the respective educational board.

A copy of the family income certificate is also required to verify the income criteria.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The disbursement of awards is typically done annually.

The awards are announced after the results of the state and district level examinations are declared.

The timeline for application submission usually coincides with the examination results.

Students are advised to keep an eye on the official announcements regarding the application dates.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

The department is responsible for the overall management and execution of the scheme.

For any queries or assistance, students can contact the department through their official helpline.

The contact details for the Department of Backward Classes Welfare can be found on their official website.

This scheme has seen a positive response since its inception.

It has encouraged many Scheduled Caste students to strive for academic excellence.

The financial assistance provided has helped many families support their children's education.

The government aims to increase awareness about this scheme to ensure that eligible students apply and benefit from it.

In recent years, the scheme has been promoted through various educational institutions.

Workshops and seminars have been organized to inform students about the benefits of the scheme.

The government has also collaborated with schools and colleges to disseminate information.

Statistics show that the number of applicants has increased each year since the scheme's launch.

In the first year alone, over 1,000 students received awards under this scheme.

The government has set a target to increase this number to 5,000 students annually in the coming years.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the government to uplift the Scheduled Caste community.

It aligns with various other welfare schemes aimed at improving educational outcomes for marginalized communities.

The Sahuji Maharaj Assistance Scheme is a testament to the government’s commitment to promoting education among Scheduled Caste students.

The scheme not only provides financial support but also serves as a recognition of hard work and dedication.

By rewarding academic excellence, the government hopes to inspire future generations to pursue education vigorously.

The initiative is a crucial step towards achieving social equity and empowerment for Scheduled Castes in Uttar Pradesh.

Overall, the Sahuji Maharaj Assistance Scheme plays a vital role in shaping the educational landscape for Scheduled Caste students in the state.
